resources.string: Required for apps that strictly verify the original Shizuku package name.

This is not a standalone app.

ShizukuX installed this small component so that apps which only recognise the original Shizuku package name (moe.shizuku.privileged.api) keep working. All actual work is handled by ShizukuX itself.

It runs no service and shows no UI of its own. Uninstalling it removes the compatibility layer; apps that check for the original Shizuku package will then report Shizuku as missing.

Tip: uninstall this component BEFORE uninstalling ShizukuX — once the manager is gone, this screen is the only remaining entry point.
